text: {"lessons":["My account has fallen substantially, and simply holding through each decline has not protected me; I should reassess each position and my overall risk using current information, not freeze or trade just to react to losses.","I tend to judge stocks separately against my purchase price and dislike admitting a mistake; average cost is not a reason to hold, so I should compare each holding’s prospects with the alternatives and act when warranted.","Losses feel especially painful, but past price changes do not predict future ones. I should avoid both panic-selling and waiting for a return to breakeven, and keep decisions consistent with diversification and risk tolerance."]}
